$comment: Install commands shown on the home page and in the docs. tests/install.test.mjs checks that each command is also in the repository README.

methods.label: macOS / Linux
methods.note: Downloads the latest release, checks its checksum and installs quiver into ~/.local/bin.

methods.label: Windows
methods.note: Installs quiver.exe into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\quiver and adds it to your user PATH, without admin rights.

methods.label: npm
methods.note: Installs the binary for your platform. No install script runs.

methods.label: Go
methods.note: Builds from source with your Go toolchain.
